item.title: Hong Kong: Sea Urchin-Inspired Autonomous Underwater Sensors
item.description: Researchers replicate sea urchin spine structure using 3D printing to create self powered underwater sensing materials for monitoring marine environments.

item.title: Vietnam: Developing a Skilled High-Technology Workforce
item.description: Vietnam is prioritising the development of a high-quality science and technology workforce under Resolution 57 to master strategic technologies, drive innovation and strengthen the country’s competitiveness.

item.title: Singapore: National Programme to Accelerate AI Adoption
item.description: Singapore’s National AI Impact Programme aims to accelerate AI adoption across businesses while developing 100,000 AI‑bilingual workers, fostering enterprise transformation and responsible innovation.

item.title: Malaysia: Market Access and Digital Readiness for Small Enterprises
item.description: Malaysia programme supports 625 entrepreneurs with digital platforms market access and technology adoption to strengthen competitiveness and business growth.

item.title: New Zealand: Expanding AI Tools Across Healthcare
item.description: New Zealand is using artificial intelligence to support emergency clinicians and enhance breast screening services, improving efficiency, early detection and patient care while maintaining high clinical standards.

item.title: Australia: Strengthening AI and Advanced Manufacturing Skills in Victoria
item.description: Victoria is expanding its Digital Jobs programme with new funding and AI-focused pathways to equip workers with advanced digital skills for technology-driven industries and future economic competitiveness.

item.title: Vietnam’s 5G Expansion Fuels Digital Economy Growth
item.description: Vietnam’s nationwide 5G rollout is accelerating digital transformation, enhancing urban management, connecting rural communities and driving economic growth, innovation and inclusive development across the country.

item.title: Hong Kong: PolyU Develops AI Ophthalmology Co-Pilot
item.description: Researchers at The Hong Kong Polytechnic University are developing EyeAgent 2.0, an advanced AI co-pilot designed to support ophthalmic diagnosis, treatment planning, and comprehensive clinical decision-making processes.

item.title: The Philippines: Digital Platform Boosts National Health Systems
item.description: A Filipino digital health platform is transforming healthcare in the Philippines by connecting patients, providers and LGUs, supporting national initiatives and enhancing access, efficiency and management.

item.title: Singapore: Raising Cybersecurity Standards for Critical Infrastructure
item.description: Singapore raises cybersecurity standards for infrastructure owners, auditors and service providers, requiring higher Cyber Trust Mark certification to strengthen national resilience and protect services.
